item.title: uSync Complete 17.4.1
item.description:
- Fix: server-to-server push requests no longer fail with `401 The request requires user authentication` when the target site has Umbraco's Basic Auth shared-secret bypass configured. The header carrying the shared secret was being mis-paired and then overwritten with the wrong value before the request went out, so the target rejected it as unauthenticated even when the secret was configured correctly on both servers
Full changelog: https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.Complete/blob/v17/main/CHANGELOG.md

item.title: Translation Manager 17.8.2
item.description:
A clone-to-language action for untranslated variants, and a dependency fix for sites also running uSync.Complete.
- Add: clone the currently viewed variant's content straight into a language with no translation yet, skipping the translation job pipeline entirely — porting the v13 clone button to the v17 backoffice. A notification confirms success or failure, and the new Clone action is styled distinctly from Create so the two read as primary vs secondary - Fix: sites running Translation Manager alongside uSync.Complete 17.4.0 could hit `400 - Read unrecognized type discriminator id 'TranslationProcessingOptions'` on translation requests — both packages depend on Jumoo.Processing, and a version mismatch between them meant two separate copies of it got loaded, so the runtime discriminator scan Jumoo.Processing uses for polymorphic options types missed ours. Aligning Translation Manager's Jumoo.Processing reference with uSync.Complete's (17.4.0) fixes it - Fix: the subscription and domain licence checkers now send a user agent header on requests to check.jumoo.co.uk, matching uSync.Complete's licence checker setup - Build: publish nightly builds to nightly.jumoo.uk
